allocation_lines_priority_source.name: allocation_lines_priority_source
allocation_lines_priority_source.value: ("allocation_lines"."wait_ticket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "allocation_lines"."priority_level" = 'P0A') OR ("allocation_lines"."order_request_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "allocation_lines"."priority_level" <> 'P0A')

allocation_lines_order_has_merged_order.name: allocation_lines_order_has_merged_order
allocation_lines_order_has_merged_order.value: "allocation_lines"."order_request_item_id" IS NULL OR "allocation_lines"."merged_order_id" IS NOT NULL

allocation_runs_finish_after_start.name: allocation_runs_finish_after_start
allocation_runs_finish_after_start.value: "allocation_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL OR "allocation_runs"."started_at" IS NULL OR "allocation_runs"."finished_at" >= "allocation_runs"."started_at"

daily_priority_offers_response_timestamp.name: daily_priority_offers_response_timestamp
daily_priority_offers_response_timestamp.value: "daily_priority_offers"."status" NOT IN ('accepted', 'declined') OR "daily_priority_offers"."responded_at" IS NOT NULL

idosi_statistics_sync_attempts_result.name: idosi_statistics_sync_attempts_result
idosi_statistics_sync_attempts_result.value:
("idosi_statistics_sync_attempts"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "idosi_statistics_sync_attempts"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL AND "idosi_statistics_sync_attempts"."error_code" IS NULL AND "idosi_statistics_sync_attempts"."error_message" IS NULL)
        OR ("idosi_statistics_sync_attempts"."status" = 'failed' AND "idosi_statistics_sync_attempts"."snapshot_id" IS NULL AND "idosi_statistics_sync_attempts"."error_code" IS NOT NULL AND "idosi_statistics_sync_attempts"."error_message" IS NOT NULL)

inventory_snapshots_session_day_type_uid.name: inventory_snapshots_session_day_type_uidx
inventory_snapshots_session_day_type_uid.where: "inventory_snapshots"."order_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_snapshots"."deleted_at" IS NULL

order_sessions_close_after_open.name: order_sessions_close_after_open
order_sessions_close_after_open.value: "order_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL OR "order_sessions"."opened_at" IS NULL OR "order_sessions"."closed_at" >= "order_sessions"."opened_at"

product_conversions_effective_period_val.name: product_conversions_effective_period_valid
product_conversions_effective_period_val.value: "product_conversions"."effective_to" IS NULL OR "product_conversions"."effective_to" > "product_conversions"."effective_from" OR ("product_conversions"."effective_to" = "product_conversions"."effective_from" AND "product_conversions"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL)

product_conversions_retirement_consisten.name: product_conversions_retirement_consistent
product_conversions_retirement_consisten.value: ("product_conversions"."retired_at" IS NULL AND "product_conversions"."retired_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "product_conversions"."retirement_reason" IS NULL) OR ("product_conversions"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "product_conversions"."retired_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "product_conversions"."retirement_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("product_conversions"."retirement_reason")) >= 3 AND "product_conversions"."effective_to" IS NOT NULL)

receipts_confirmation_timestamp.name: receipts_confirmation_timestamp
receipts_confirmation_timestamp.value: "receipts"."status" <> 'confirmed' OR ("receipts"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "receipts"."received_at" IS NOT NULL)

reservations_active_allocation_line_uidx.name: reservations_active_allocation_line_uidx
reservations_active_allocation_line_uidx.where: "reservations"."allocation_line_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reservations"."status" = 'active' AND "reservations"."deleted_at" IS NULL

reservations_active_outbound_line_idx.name: reservations_active_outbound_line_idx
reservations_active_outbound_line_idx.where: "reservations"."outbound_request_line_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reservations"."status" = 'active' AND "reservations"."deleted_at" IS NULL

store_inventory_bags_exactly_one_provena.name: store_inventory_bags_exactly_one_provenance
store_inventory_bags_exactly_one_provena.value: (("store_inventory_bags"."source_store_receipt_bag_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("store_inventory_bags"."source_transfer_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer) = 1

store_inventory_bags_transfer_parent.name: store_inventory_bags_transfer_parent
store_inventory_bags_transfer_parent.value: "store_inventory_bags"."source_transfer_id" IS NULL OR "store_inventory_bags"."source_inventory_bag_id" IS NOT NULL

store_outbounds_review_state.name: store_outbounds_review_state
store_outbounds_review_state.value: "store_outbounds"."status" = 'pending' OR ("store_outbounds"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "store_outbounds"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

store_receipts_submission_state.name: store_receipts_submission_state
store_receipts_submission_state.value: "store_receipts"."status" = 'draft' OR ("store_receipts"."declared_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "store_receipts"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)

store_receipts_finalized_state.name: store_receipts_finalized_state
store_receipts_finalized_state.value: "store_receipts"."status" <> 'finalized' OR ("store_receipts"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "store_receipts"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)

store_transfers_dispatch_state.name: store_transfers_dispatch_state
store_transfers_dispatch_state.value: "store_transfers"."status" = 'draft' OR "store_transfers"."status" = 'cancelled' OR ("store_transfers"."cost_vnd" IS NOT NULL AND "store_transfers"."dispatched_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "store_transfers"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL)

store_transfers_receive_state.name: store_transfers_receive_state
store_transfers_receive_state.value: "store_transfers"."status" <> 'received' OR ("store_transfers"."destination_inventory_bag_id" IS NOT NULL AND "store_transfers"."received_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "store_transfers"."received_at" IS NOT NULL)

users_store_scope_matches_role.name: users_store_scope_matches_role
users_store_scope_matches_role.value: ("users"."role" = 'store' AND "users"."store_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("users"."role" <> 'store' AND "users"."store_id" IS NULL)
